author: Copilot
body:
The pre-initialize assertion is currently checking `mock_client.capture.assert_not_called()` even though `mock_client` is not attached to the tracker until later, so this part of the test can’t actually detect an accidental emit before `initialize()`. Consider asserting on the tracker’s internal state (e.g., `_client is None`) or patching/spying on `tracker._capture` to verify no capture attempt occurs before initialization.
```suggestion
    # Before initialize, the tracker should remain uninitialized and not attach a client
    assert tracker._client is None
    await tracker.track_tool_call(account_id=uuid4(), tool_name="noop", success=True)
    assert tracker._client is None
```

author: Copilot
body:
`STACK_ENVIRONMENT` tiers in this repo include `test` (see CDK get_env_tier), but this logic treats anything other than `dev`/`production` as “unsupported”. If `test` should be a valid non-tracking environment, handle it explicitly (and adjust the log message accordingly). If it should track, include `test` in the enabled set so PostHog isn’t silently disabled in that tier.
```suggestion
    elif env == "test":
        log.info("PostHog disabled in test environment")
    else:
        log.info("PostHog disabled: unknown STACK_ENVIRONMENT=%s", env)
```
